name: Rioseco de Soria (Spain)
description: Square flag vertically divided blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rioseco de Soria (a pillory and ears of wheat on blue and white above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Rioseco de Soria; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
